name: Hurricane Michael, Oct 2018
description: US Hurricane wind footprint for Hurricane Michael, October 11-12 2018. It made landfall near Mexico Beach, Florida as a Category 4 hurricane before weakening to a tropical storm.

vulnerability.source: Emanuel (2011) wind damage function, from the Oasis VulnerabilityLibrary
vulnerability.description: One function for every building: damage ratio = v³ / (1 + v³), where v = (V − 57.5) / (167.1 − 57.5) and V is the peak gust in mph from ARA's wind footprint (Emanuel's thresholds of 25.7 and 74.7 m/s, converted to mph). Emanuel defined the function for sustained wind speeds, so applying it to gusts gives higher damage. Building type and occupancy are not used. Emanuel, K. (2011), Global warming effects on U.S. hurricane damage, Weather, Climate, and Society 3, 261–268.
